newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Murdoch says STAR TV performing well.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Murdoch says STAR TV performing well.

text.p: ADELAIDE, Oct 15 (Retuer) - News Corp Ltd chairman Rupert Murdoch said on Tuesday that its pan-Asian satellite broadcaster, STAR TV, was performing well.
"I think the oulook's just great," Murdoch told reporters after the company's annual meeting, when asked about STAR's performance.
When asked what STAR TV's losses would be in the current 1996/97 year, Murdoch said: "It won't have any losses, it's just a degree of how much we're investing in it."
Murdoch told last year's annual meeting that STAR TV would make losses of up to US$80 million in 1995/96.
In its 1995/96 annual results released in August, News Corp did not reveal the size of STAR TV's losses but said they were in line with expectations.
Murdoch on Monday would not make any further comment to reports about Star.
